mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at 63 degrees over the Badger Ridge Middle School area with a waning gibbous moon.

City updates today include the closure of Fireman's Park Beach for the 2027 season, while the splash pad remains open daily from 9 AM to 7 PM. Additionally, please keep an eye out for potential letters from the Water Utility regarding cross connection inspections to keep our water supply safe.

Looking at our calendar, we have Yoga at Insight Wellness, Art Bar Happy Hour at ART House 360, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co. all taking place today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market on October 3.
In our weekly police report, on September 21, officers identified and cited a suspect for the retail theft of Swedish Fish candy from a retailer located in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue.
Culver's of Verona is open until 10 PM today, so stop by to enjoy their delicious flavor of the day, Chocolate Heath Crunch.
